title: FREESURFER FuseSegmentations

in_norms.desc: -n <filename>  - name of norm file to use (default: norm.mgs)         must include the corresponding norm file for all given timepoints         as well as for the current subject

in_segmentations.desc: name of aseg file to use (default: aseg.mgz)         must include the aseg files for all the given timepoints

in_segmentations_noCC.desc: name of aseg file w/o CC labels (default: aseg.auto_noCCseg.mgz)         must include the corresponding file for all the given timepoints

timepoints.desc: subject_ids or timepoints to be processed

description: fuse segmentations together from multiple timepoints
